name: local-llm
summary: Zero-dependency local LLM runner (LM Studio / Ollama) with a verify-gated red-to-green file transform loop, a zero-floor input budget rail, role evals, and loopback-only enforcement.

action.none: No honest shell matcher. Whether a local-model invocation stays on the machine depends on the resolved endpoint (`--base-url`, `PORTULAN_LOCAL_LLM_URL`, or a proxy config), not on the binary name. `runner/local-llm.mjs` refuses non-loopback hosts in code unless `--allow-remote` is passed; this fragment records the policy boundary that a host permission rule cannot see.

gates.reason: Routing a task to a local model is a spend and confidentiality boundary only while the endpoint resolves to loopback (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, `[::1]`). Pointing a local worker at a remote endpoint sends workspace context off-machine under a local tool's name; propose the remote endpoint explicitly before running.
